posts.title: Happy Holidays!
posts.description: Merry Christmas, Happy Yule, Happy Hanukkah, Happy Kwanzaa — and Happy New Year to you. I’m still alive and kicking, although life has been kicking me around more than usual. 2025 has been rough. I’m hoping 2026 has better days to come.
